items.title: James "Sugarboy" Crawford Interview, 1975-04-29
items.q: Bobby Mitchell, he cut everybody loose. ... Bobby Mitchell recorded that number. It's true.

ctx.x: He cut Smiley Loose, Loose too. Bobby Mitchell, he cut everybody loose.
Yeah, well, Bobby told me that, uh, he, he had a suit against Lou Chez. Because he, he was, he should have gotten some money from the Wheel record. I remember there, Wheel someday.
